pull_request.title: Calorimeter: summarize EM findings in an eight-page review
pull_request.head: codex/emcal-findings-report
pull_request.body:
Creates an eight-page EM calorimeter findings review, including references, from ODD through realistic nODD Si-W to ALLEGRO-style LAr. It summarizes physical cracks, staggering, calibration limits, updated routing, matched response evidence and prioritized recommendations. Per explicit project direction the updated routing and400mm warm gap are treated as merged/adopted working configuration; integrated service/engineering qualification remains distinct. Documentation only; no simulation, geometry or formal sign-off change.

Deliverable: `docs/publication/emcal-findings/review.pdf`, with editable source, immutable input hashes and reproduction recipe. Sources pin79a967aa plus historical3ebafd34 for continuous-silicon/staggering and independent100k-training/20k-validation calibration studies. Fixed-point ODD/nODD, matched10k H/E and complete LAr A/E cohorts/thresholds remain separate. Vector figures preserve retained bin values and percentile endpoints; the routing schematic makes no installed-fit claim.

Validation: exactly8pages <=10; no layout overflow; all8finalpages visually checked; footer/link/bounds/glyph/hash checks pass; PDF rebuilds byte-identically (72041bytes). Separate PubDoc and PhysVal reviews at38bc3b6b found no actionable findings. Finaltwo priority labels were shortened cosmetically; all7other pagecontentstreams remain byte-identical (review-delta.json). Required project/session/inventory/interaction/token validations and preview build pass. Raw data and rendered QA images remain ignored.

Work: M1 / WS-PUB / TASK-EMCAL-FINDINGS, DES-030/031/032/033. Four exact completed current-task specialist turns are uniquely logged; active coordinator usage remains unavailable. Stacked on #144 to retain its source evidence, with actual hosting state distinct from the report's user-directed adoption convention. Remains draft for review.
